cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Hello, Linda speaking.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Oh hi, Linda. This is Matt Brooks. Alex White gave me your number. He said you’d be able to give me some advice about moving to Banford.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Yes, Alex did mention you. How can I help?

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Well, first of all - which area to live in?

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Well, I live in Dalton (Example), which is a really nice suburb - not too expensive, and there’s a nice park.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Sounds good. Do you know how much it would be to rent a two bedroom flat there?

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Yeah, you should be able to get something reasonable for 850 (Q1) pounds per month. That’s what people typically pay. You certainly wouldn’t want to pay more than 900 pounds. That doesn’t include bills or anything.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: No. That sound alright. I’ll definitely have a look there. Are the transport links easy from where you live?

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Well, I’m very lucky. I work in the city centre so I don’t have to use public transport. I go by bike. (Q2)

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Oh, I wish I could do that. Is it safe to cycle around the city?

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Yes, it’s fine. And it keeps me fit. Anyway, driving to work in the city centre would be a nightmare because there’s hardly any parking (Q3). And the traffic during the rush hour can be bad.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: I’d be working from home but I’d have to go to London one or two days a week.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Oh, that’s perfect. Getting to London is no problem. There’s a fast train every 30 minutes (Q4) which only takes 45 minutes.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: That’s good.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Yeah, the train service isn’t bad during the week. And they run quite late at night. It’s weekends that are a problem (Q5). They’re always doing engineering work and you have to take a bus to Hadham and pick up the train there, which is really slow. But other than that, Banford’s a great place to live. I’ve never been happier.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: There are some nice restaurants in the city centre and a brand new cinema which has only been open a couple of months (Q6). There’s a good arts centre too.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Sounds like Banford’s got it all.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Yes! We’re really lucky. There are lots of really good aspects to living here. The schools are good and the hospital here is one of the best in the country (Q7). Everyone I know who’s been there’s had a positive experience. Oh, I can give you the name of my dentist too in Bridge Street (Q8), if you’re interested. I’ve been going to him for years and I’ve never had any problems.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Oh, OK. Thanks!

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: I’ll find his number and send it to you.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Thanks, that would be really helpful.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Are you planning to visit Banford soon?

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Yes. My wife and I are both coming next week. We want to make some appointments with estate agents.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: I could meet you if you like and show you around.

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Are you sure? We’d really appreciate that.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Either a Tuesday or Thursday is good for me, after 5.30. (Q9)

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Thursday’s preferable - Tuesday I need to get home before 6 pm.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: Okay great. Let me know which train your catching and I’ll meet you in the cafe outside. You can’t miss it. It’s opposite the station and next to the museum. (Q10)

cues.speaker: MATT
cues.text: Brilliant. I’ll text you next week then. Thanks so much for all the advice.

cues.speaker: LINDA
cues.text: No problem. I’ll see you next week.
